notes.title: Driver update
notes.content:
Hey guys, sorry for the long wait!

I just updated the driver (both the default and the beta branch) with [url=https://github.com/r57zone/Razer-Hydra-SteamVR-driver/]r57zone's fixes[/url]. This should provide full compatibility with Vive controllers. I hope this fixes all problems for now.

notes.title: v1.1.2 released
notes.content:
- Added default.vrsettings to maintain compatibility with latest SteamVR beta
- Developer mode: the ingame toggling of the e-imu has been moved to developer mode, which can be enabled by editing steamvr.vrsettings. It can be used with Button 1, Button 2 toggles angular velocity.
- Settings key names changed, see the contents of default.vrsettings
